_doc: T310 Sword_Idle key poses (spec work/player/d-04-player-sword-idle.md; SI1 = key poses only, in-betweens later). Redesigned within the P2c sweeps from the reference player-idle.mp4 (not copied). f1 rest / exhale, f43 inhale peak, f72 return + settle, f91 = f1 via the loop closing keys. Right arm FK held (upper arm twisted out Y 45 so the forearm points out-forward, elbow ~105-110 deg: the player's 0.166 m arm segments put a 90 deg fist at z ~0.56 m, well above the belt at ~0.42 m; the fist centre sits at z ~0.51 m), wrist set so the placeholder blade (contract: socket +Z) points up and ~13 deg outward. Left arm lowered 15 deg (relaxed). Breath: COG up 7 mm (CTRL_torso loc Y -0.008 -> -0.001; knees straighten at about 0.0, so the rise stays below it), chest up (chest X -3, spine_01 X -1), shoulder shrug 6 deg; at f43 the upper arms lower 5 deg against the shrug (R Z 10 -> 15, L Z -15 -> -20) so the fists rise with the shoulders without swinging out (T310 probe: without it the right fist rose 48 mm and moved 16 mm outward). | T312 SI2 timing (key poses f1 / f43 / f72 kept): breath channels ease through the auto-clamped extremes at f43 (inhale peak) and f72 (settle); f72 -> f91 drifts torso loc Y -0.009 -> -0.008 and chest X 0.5 -> 0 (never frozen). Seam: breakdowns at f7 and f85 give the f1 and f91 endpoint handles the same slope (torso 3.17e-5 m/frame, chest -0.0158 deg/frame; channels with f72 = f1 get a flat f7 key so both seam slopes are 0). Overlap: the upper-arm keys (shrug compensation) move 3 frames earlier (f40 / f69 instead of f43 / f72), so the world-space fists and the sword peak after the torso; head counters the chest tilt (X +1 at f46, lag 3).
